title: PECO: Examining Single Sentence Label Leakage in Natural Language Inference Datasets through Progressive Evaluation of Cluster Outliers

bias_targets.target: Dataset artifact bias (Single sentence label leakage)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Natural Language Inference (NLI) models by comparing their performance, output agreement, and token relevance in standard paired-sentence conditions versus single-sentence conditions (hypothesis or premise only). The paper also introduces the Progressive Evaluation of Cluster Outliers (PECO) metric, which measures the divergence of local label distributions within k-means clustered sentence embeddings to identify regions of latent space exhibiting spurious annotator correlations.

primary_bias_target: Dataset artifact bias (Single sentence label leakage)
